strings.root-content: A low roof gathers the rain. Its rooms share one battered ledger and a stubborn clock.
strings.taproom-content:
Rain ticks against the shutters. The map beside the lamp marks a stair down to the cellar.

![[asset:sha256:db74122853c858b16bcc3b58363d3bdd89c38f9f720240626458f13c21219399|A small map of the tavern lane]]

![[asset:sha256:dadc41ce60b07eb817ef2b92628e664126cd877fcfb0628278e89bd7f9acb690|Night birds beyond the shutters]]

The cellar door leads to [[node:cellar|the cellar]]. 夜が来る前に、灯りをつけて。
strings.cellar-content: Rowan keeps the dry stores here and listens to the weather above.
strings.mira-first-text: Mira lowers her voice. “The lantern has not rung true since the old road flooded.”
strings.rowan-first-text: Rowan pauses by the shelves. “You heard it too?”
strings.rowan-secret-text: Rowan leans closer. “The chime means the upper road is safe again.”
strings.mira-after-return-text: Mira gives you a small nod. “You came back. Take this, if you mean to help.”
strings.mira-farewell-text: Mira returns to the ledger as the rain softens.
strings.option-interrupt: Ask Rowan what the chime means
